	custom_tooltip = aov_spell_combat_ward_cost_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		aov_mana_spend = { AMOUNT = aov_spell_combat_ward_cost }
		aov_school_add_progress = { SCHOOL = abjuration AMOUNT = 25 }
		add_magic_lifestyle_xp = 25
		set_variable = { name = aov_spell_combat_ward_cd years = aov_spell_combat_ward_years }
	}
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_spell_combat_ward years = aov_spell_combat_ward_years }
}

	custom_tooltip = aov_spell_chronophage_cost_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		aov_mana_spend = { AMOUNT = aov_spell_chronophage_cost }
		aov_school_add_progress = { SCHOOL = necromancy AMOUNT = 200 }
		add_magic_lifestyle_xp = 200
		set_variable = { name = aov_spell_chronophage_cd years = aov_spell_chronophage_years }
	}
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_spell_chronophage years = aov_spell_chronophage_years }
	aov_dark_magic_roll = yes
}
